children: The win probability for the Miami Marlins option in Polymarket’s Miami Marlins vs. Chicago Cubs market fell sharply from 31.5% one hour earlier to 15%, a 16.5 percentage-point drop. According to ChainCatcher, the move reflects sudden volatility in the prediction market and may be linked to breaking news.

title: Polymarket Miami Marlins Option Drops to 15% Amid Sharp Volatility
